title: City of Miami Approves Controversial GTA6 Advertising Campaign
description: The City of Miami Beach has approved marketing campaign negotiations with Rockstar Games for GTA6, bringing millions in ads under discreet conditions.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Miami Beach Approves Rockstar Games Marketing Talks

According to a recent report by Eurogamer, the City of Miami Beach has officially approved negotiations with Rockstar Games regarding an upcoming marketing campaign. This major collaboration is set to bring advertisements for the highly anticipated Grand Theft Auto 6 into the seaside city in exchange for millions of dollars.

## A Controversial and Restricted Rollout

The approval comes in the wake of local discussions and controversies surrounding the partnership. As the source notes, some perspectives questioned the worth of such a campaign, with remarks highlighting that it might not be worth any amount of money. To address these concerns, the approved terms dictate that the brand can only appear "discreetly" within the city.

This stipulation ensures that while Rockstar Games secures its presence in the real-world counterpart of Vice City, the advertisements will maintain a low profile, avoiding disruptive or overly flashy displays along the seaside.

## Editor's Take

Bringing GTA6 advertising to Miami Beach creates a fascinating bridge between fiction and reality. While the "discreet" requirement shows local caution, millions of dollars changing hands proves the immense commercial gravity surrounding Rockstar's upcoming blockbuster.
